technical-summary: New release automation: after an engine release the release-please workflow merges main into the exact same-repository platform release PR branch. Every merge, clean or conflicting, takes its manifest from the pure rule (platform version from the PR head, other packages from main; refuses other conflicts, key-set mismatch, downgrades); the branch is updated by a compare-and-swap push on the expected head; UNKNOWN mergeability is retried and a timeout is a named deferred state; credentials stay out of argv and checkout. The rule moved to manifest_reconcile and pin-release uses it. The PR is never merged.
user-summary-candidate: The platform release PR no longer needs a hand-merged manifest after an engine release.
